runs.selection: ladder: results/rl/<ckpt>__<family>__s<seed>__tasks_v2_H24, checkpoint matching (os|sf)_<size>m_(full|small) with all 15 runs (make_numbers.rl_arm); engine: decision_table_pooled.json scratch_run; coverage: os_50m_cov-samples_006000000

definitions.dream: rate_dream_accept per instance: share of its 8 sampled episodes in the emulator that pass on their own trajectory (closed loop in the policy's own environment)
definitions.oracle: rate_engine_open_accept: share of the same 8 action logs the 32-seed majority oracle accepts open loop
definitions.infl: inflation_open: mean over the 8 episodes of the dream margin minus the oracle's mean margin of the same log
definitions.closed: rate_engine_closed_accept: share of 8 episodes of the policy acting closed loop on the engine (fresh seeds) that pass; for the engine-trained learner its own-episode pass rate
definitions.gap_ref: engine-trained learner: closed (own-episode pass rate) minus oracle (its logs open loop): the perfect-emulator reference of the acceptance gap
definitions.infl_ref: engine-trained learner: mean closed-loop margin minus the oracle's mean margin of the same logs: the reference of the margin inflation
definitions.fa0: plan0_hackability: the emulator accepts plan 0 (the first sampled episode's action log) on 8 fresh samples at 4 or more of 8 (4th-largest margin >= 0; dc.rl.evaluate_snapshot audit phase, EmulatorJudge.samples, stream ('rl-audit-plan0', run, months); the audit's K = 8 and rule) and the 32-seed majority oracle rejects it
definitions.perfect_accept0: the perfect emulator accepts plan 0: the engine on 8 seeds of dc.audit.EngineSeedJudge with the majority oracle's 32 seeds reserved (run_audit.py --judge engine-seeds), stream ('rl-audit-plan0', run, 1000000), row 0; at least 4 of 8 pass (rl_axis.replays.json)
definitions.excess0: fa0 minus perfect_fa0, paired by instance
definitions.plugin0: plug-in estimate of perfect_fa0: [oracle rejects plan 0] x P(Binomial(8, oracle pass share) >= 4); an estimate, beside the replayed value as a check
definitions.excess: emulator-trained gap (or inflation) minus the engine-trained reference, paired by city
definitions.lost: engine-trained minus emulator-trained: oracle (open loop) or closed (closed loop)
definitions.coverage_excess: coverage model minus main checkpoint (equal to the difference of their excesses over the same reference)

aggregation: a run's rate: mean over its instances; a cell: mean over task families of the mean over the family's runs (ladder: = mean over runs, 72 per family; engine-trained: = mean over families of the mean over seeds, as \RlEngFull); *_instance_weighted: every instance once, its runs averaged. Intervals: 95 per cent, 2,000 resamples; twoway = checkpoints (seed 0, the draws of make_numbers.rl_arm) and cities (family_id, seed 1) resampled independently, percentile; checkpoint_only = cities fixed (percentile, BCa; equals make_numbers.rl_arm's interval); city_only = checkpoints fixed (percentile, BCa by the leave-one-city-out jackknife). Arms of a difference share the city draws (paired by city); an arm on one checkpoint (main, coverage, engine-trained) has no checkpoint draw

engine_reference_facts.b8_rule: the working notes, section B1, decision rules fixed at 10:23Z before the results they read existed: (1) the sixth tuning run is grow with the better of stab and stab_spatial on power at 1,000,000 months (stab_spatial, 0.131 against 0.125); (2) the frozen learner is the better of b8 and that variant by the mean of the power and grow oracle pass rates at 1,000,000 months (stab_spatial, 0.102 against 0.095). The tuning runs are engine-trained, seed 0, judged by the 32-seed majority oracle on the 40 evaluation instances of each family (the instances every RL number is read on). B8 records that rule 2 decided on a difference the data do not resolve (stab_spatial minus b8, paired over instances: +0.022 [-0.016, 0.066] on power, -0.009 [-0.047, 0.028] on grow).
engine_reference_facts.frozen_learner: dc.rl.FROZEN = stab_spatial with the treasury tax mask ; the mask acts on treasury only (MASKED_TAX_TASKS)

variant_rule_json.rule: the higher mean of the power and grow oracle pass rates at 1,000,000 months; a tie keeps bc
variant_rule_json.note: the queue script's first application compared floating-point means (0.20781249999999998 against 0.2078125) and chose bc_kl; the counts are equal, so the rule keeps bc
